common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.tagline: Your njangi (tontine) ledger, in black and white.
auth.signInDesc: Enter your phone number. A code arrives by SMS.
auth.signUpDesc: Your phone number is enough. A code arrives by SMS.
auth.custodyNote: No fees. Your money never passes through the app.
auth.finishingSignInBody: Connecting your account. This only takes a moment.
auth.nativeBuildRequiredBody: Sign-in needs the Clerk native module. Run a development build (bun run ios / android) instead of Expo Go.

onboarding.title: What does the group call you?
onboarding.desc: This name will appear in your group's ledger.

home.heading: My njangis
home.emptyBody: Create your own, or ask your president for the invite link.

wizard.title: Create a njangi
wizard.modeViaTreasurerDesc: Members hand their contribution to the treasurer, who hands the pot to the round's beneficiary.
wizard.modeDirectDesc: Each member hands their contribution directly to the round's beneficiary.
wizard.modeCustodyNote: Either way, the money moves by MoMo, Orange Money or cash — never through the app.
wizard.roleHint: The person creating the group is often the treasurer — pick your real role.
wizard.inviteHint: Send the code in your njangi's WhatsApp group. You can also add members yourself.

detail.addMemberTitle: Add a member without a smartphone
detail.addMemberDesc: For members who don't have the app: you keep the ledger for them. If they sign up later with this number, they get their place and history back.
detail.setupBanner_one: {{count}} member added — start the cycle once everyone has joined.
detail.setupBanner_other: {{count}} members added — start the cycle once everyone has joined.
detail.rotationPlaceholder: Cycle start, rotation order and rounds will appear here very soon.

invite.title: Invite members
invite.whatsappMessage: Join our njangi (tontine) "{{groupName}}" on the Njangi app. Invite code: {{code}}. In the app, tap "I have a code" and enter it. The app replaces the notebook — the money never passes through it.

join.title: Join with a code
join.desc: Enter the 6-character code you received on WhatsApp, or paste the invite message.
join.invalid: That code isn't valid. Check the message you received.
join.requestSentBody: The president or treasurer needs to approve you. You'll be notified.

cycle.title: Start the cycle
cycle.subtitle: Arrange the collection order, then lock it. Once locked it's fixed and visible to everyone.
cycle.presidentOnly: Only the president can lock and start the cycle.
cycle.confirmBody: The order will be fixed and visible to all members. It can't be re-drafted afterwards — later changes only happen through a turn swap by the president.
cycle.lockedToast: Cycle started — the order is locked ✓
cycle.setupReady: Everyone's in? Arrange the rotation order and start the cycle.
cycle.setupWaiting: The president will start the cycle once everyone has joined.

round.title: Round {{n}}
round.notOpenBody: Contributions for this round open at the start of the period. You will be notified.
round.noObligation: No contribution expected from you this round.

pay.title: Contribute · Round {{n}} · {{amount}}
pay.cashBody: Bring {{amount}} to the next meeting. {{name}} will tick your name in Meeting Mode.
pay.cashClaimCta: I already handed over the cash → Declare
pay.custodyNote: The money goes directly from your account to {{name}}'s. The app never touches your money.
pay.banner: ⚠ The *126# / #150# menus can change. Verify each step against what your phone shows.
pay.amountPrefilled: Prefilled: remaining to contribute. Declare what you actually sent.
pay.proofNote: ℹ {{name}}'s confirmation is what makes the payment official — not the proof.
pay.overWarning: Amount above what remains expected — declare what you actually sent.
pay.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in F.
